description: Guinea-Bissau air force Skyservant standing on a landside plot at Osvaldo Vieira International Airport, about 120 m from the terminal and 200 m from the Osvaldo Vieira memorial, beside Avenida dos Combatentes da Liberdade da Pátria. The preserved status dates only from 2016, but the airframe is plainly present on Esri 0.34 m imagery acquired 16 March 2026, the most current imagery in this survey.
